Brown struggled mightily to block Rams pass rusher Robert Quinn, and Payton moved Zach Strief from right to left tackle to replace him midway through the game. Afterward, Payton was asked why he benched Brown and famously said, "I'd seen enough." From there, Armstead started every game at left tackle for the next nine seasons, earning three Pro Bowl berths along the way.
